response.final_text:
**Proposed disposition:** CLOSE_FP, confidence 0.90. It is a proposal only, and a human decides.

**The three facts that drove it:**
1. T-MM-02 is a registered market maker on SYN.A. It quoted paired BUY and SELL limit orders of 381 each, re-quoted every few seconds. Cancels were symmetric across sides (0.957), and no order exceeded 0.15x depth.
2. There was no opposite-side (BUY) execution at all. The only fills were partial fills on the trader's own SELL quotes (2,113 in total, 16% of the dominant-side quantity submitted). Feature (b), a benefit from an opposite-side execution, is absent.
3. No public event, risk event, repetition of the cycle or large order explains or adds to the pattern. The detector's trigger is the gross size of many small quotes.

**What would change my mind:** a BUY execution by the trader at a price that one-sided resting size had moved, followed by reversion. One-sided quotes well above desk-typical size would also change it.
